read.title: Suspicious Seller on Our Listing
read.text:
Team,

A new seller called "BestDealz" joined our Snail Repair Cream listing yesterday and is selling it 30% below our price. We have reason to believe the items are counterfeit, because the photos in their reviews show a different cap color.

I placed a test buy this morning. When the package arrives, we will compare the batch number with our records. If it is fake, we will report the seller through Brand Registry and ask Amazon to take action.

Please do not lower our price for now.

Minsu

write.task: 테스트 구매로 위조품을 확인했어요. 셀러 지원팀에 해당 판매자를 신고하고 조치를 요청하는 짧은 메시지를 써 보세요.
write.en: Write a short message to Seller Support reporting a seller of counterfeit products and asking them to take action.
write.model:
Hello,

I'm contacting you to report a seller on our listing. We have reason to believe they are selling counterfeit products. Our test buy showed a fake batch number and different packaging. Please take action against this seller as soon as possible.

Thank you,
Minsu
